requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Getting started with メモット"}, {"id": 1, "text": "メモット is a note app that lets you combine text, tables, and images in one place."}, {"id": 2, "text": "This guide uses an example of 月見里(やまなし) from Public Relations and 小鳥遊(たかなし) from Sales."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "A short note attached to a page is called a \"Hitokoto\" (Quick Note)."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Yamanashi-san records the decisions from the meeting in a Hitokoto."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Yamanashi-san puts sticky notes on important parts as markers."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "You can add up to ten notes per page."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Using it with your team"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Takanashi's sales team first created a workspace."}, {"id": 2, "text": "A place inside the workspace that everyone can see is called \"Commons\" (ひろば)."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Anyone can post notes in the Commons."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Takanashi-san shares the sales schedule in the Commons every morning."}, {"id": 2, "text": "You can invite members to the workspace by email."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The invited person will receive a confirmation email."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Once an administrator approves, you can join right away."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Member permissions can also be changed for each hiroba."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Sync and history"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Notes are saved automatically and synced to all of your devices."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You can keep editing while offline, and changes sync as soon as you reconnect."}, {"id": 2, "text": "You can restore an earlier version from the page history."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Mr. Yamanashi got back the text they had accidentally deleted."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Tips for organizing"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Pinning important pages is convenient."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Pinned pages appear at the top of the list."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Tagging notes in Hiroba makes them easier to find."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You can create tags freely ◆"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Takanashi-san sorts tags by project."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The same tag can also be used for a single word or phrase."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "In search, you can look for both 広場 and ひとこと at the same time."}, {"id": 1, "text": "If you can't find something, try widening the search scope."}]}

translations.1: Getting started with メモット
translations.10: A place inside the workspace that everyone can see is called "Commons" (ひろば).
translations.11: Anyone can post notes in the Commons.
translations.12: Takanashi-san shares the sales schedule in the Commons every morning.
translations.13: You can invite members to the workspace by email.
translations.14: The invited person will receive a confirmation email.
translations.15: Once an administrator approves, you can join right away.
translations.16: Member permissions can also be changed for each hiroba.
translations.18: Notes are saved automatically and synced to all of your devices.
translations.19: You can keep editing while offline, and changes sync as soon as you reconnect.
translations.2: メモット is a note app that lets you combine text, tables, and images in one place.
translations.20: You can restore an earlier version from the page history.
translations.21: Mr. Yamanashi got back the text they had accidentally deleted.
translations.24: Pinned pages appear at the top of the list.
translations.25: Tagging notes in Hiroba makes them easier to find.
translations.28: The same tag can also be used for a single word or phrase.
translations.29: In search, you can look for both 広場 and ひとこと at the same time.
translations.3: This guide uses an example of 月見里(やまなし) from Public Relations and 小鳥遊(たかなし) from Sales.
translations.30: If you can't find something, try widening the search scope.
translations.4: A short note attached to a page is called a "Hitokoto" (Quick Note).
translations.5: Yamanashi-san records the decisions from the meeting in a Hitokoto.
translations.6: Yamanashi-san puts sticky notes on important parts as markers.
translations.7: You can add up to ten notes per page.
translations.9: Takanashi's sales team first created a workspace.
